description: While drafting the Stage 5 certification remediation plan, adopted Tim Rayburn's examination report characterization of 'Ralph' and 'David' as agents without verifying with David, and initially scoped Stage 3 artifacts to only 4 agents (Chief, Knox, Rigby, coordinator), omitting Harper, Quinn, Galen, Sterling, Chase, Shep, and Ralph.
correction: Ralph IS an agent (boot verification); David is not an agent, he is the human operator/controller; Jarvis is the Master agent itself, not a separate agent from Master; and Stage 3 scope covers all 11 named agents (Jarvis, Chief, Chase, Knox, Shep, Quinn, Harper, Rigby, Sterling, Galen, Ralph), prioritizing candidate-workflow step owners.
systemic_fix: When transcribing external reviewers' terminology (agent names, roles) into IES plans, verify identity claims against agents/master.md and agents/routing.md naming before writing them into plan documents; flag reviewer misreads explicitly in submission cover notes.
